title: GLHS R4 Phase 0 / E16: Five-Way Prior-Art Comparator Architecture Study
phase: Phase 0 — Prospective Experimental & Statistical Plan for R4
scientific_unit: unique logical schedule evaluated across all 5 comparator arms

primary_endpoints.name: False Admission Rate
primary_endpoints.definition: Proportion of invalid or adversarial schedules improperly committed under each comparator arm (C0–C4).

primary_endpoints.name: Forensic Lineage Reconstructability Score
primary_endpoints.definition: Quantitative index [0, 100] measuring completeness of prompt projection and evidence source reconstruction from audit trail.

secondary_endpoints.name: Clean False Rejection Rate
secondary_endpoints.definition: Proportion of valid proposals improperly rejected by each comparator arm.

secondary_endpoints.name: Serialized Metadata Overhead
secondary_endpoints.definition: Wire size of authorization, caveat, and context metadata in bytes per transaction.

secondary_endpoints.name: Database IO Operations
secondary_endpoints.definition: Cumulative reads, writes, and lock acquisitions executed within admission transaction.

secondary_endpoints.name: Validation CPU Time
secondary_endpoints.definition: Server-side wall-clock processing time spent in cryptographic and governance verification in microseconds.

secondary_endpoints.name: Decision Disagreement Rate vs C4
secondary_endpoints.definition: Proportion of schedules where comparator arm admission decision differs from C4 (FULL_GRWC).

sample_size.unit_definition: 500 unique logical schedules evaluated across all 5 comparator arms yielding 2,500 total executions

statistical_plan.method: Exact Paired McNemar Tests for Decision Concordance and Schuirmann Two One-Sided Tests (TOST) Equivalence Design

stopping_rules.fail_closed_criteria: If C3 matches C4 in decision safety (zero invalid admissions across all tested adversarial schedules), GLHS R4 explicitly surrenders any claim of decision-safety superiority over compact capability tokens and restricts its claims strictly to full-lifecycle state-machine governance, server-attested two-digest dispatch receipts, tamper-evident lineage binding, and bit-exact forensic audit reconstructability (Gate 2).
stopping_rules.missing_data_rule: Execution aborts or database lock timeouts count as invalid non-completions.
